intent: Leave the farm lane for a narrow hedgeway, pass through its tunnels and gaps, climb over the hedge and return to the countryside.

sections.name: The open farm lane
sections.lesson: Find the entrance between the farm hedges

signs.text:

sections.name: Gaps through the hedge
sections.lesson: Drop through the hedge’s separated tunnels

signs.text:

sections.name: The raised hedge-top route
